## MEDIUM IMPACT

### Component: `hui-area-card` — `ha-tile-info` primary text clamping

**What changed:** In `src/panels/lovelace/cards/hui-area-card.ts`, the two-line truncation behaviour for `ha-tile-info.twoline` was migrated away from CSS custom properties to a direct `::part(primary)` rule:

```css
/* BEFORE */
ha-tile-info.twoline {
  --ha-tile-info-primary-line-clamp: 2;
  --ha-tile-info-primary-line-height: var(--ha-space-4);
}

/* AFTER */
ha-tile-info.twoline::part(primary) {
  display: -webkit-box;
  -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
  -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
  white-space: normal;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
```

**Effect on ha-lcars:** The CSS custom properties `--ha-tile-info-primary-line-clamp` and `--ha-tile-info-primary-line-height` have been **removed** from the HA source. If any ha-lcars variant or downstream user has card-mod rules that set these variables on `ha-tile-info` (e.g. inside `card-mod-card-yaml` targeting `.type-area` or `hui-area-card`), those rules will silently have no effect. The area card tile names will now follow the new `::part(primary)` sizing exclusively.

The ha-lcars preamble does not currently reference `--ha-tile-info-primary-line-clamp` or `--ha-tile-info-primary-line-height` directly, so there is no immediate breakage. However, `overflow-wrap: anywhere` on the primary label part may reflow tile name text in the area card in a way that is visually inconsistent with other LCARS tile-info usages where the theme sets `white-space` or line-height expectations.

**Suggested fix:** If any LCARS variant card-mod rules set `--ha-tile-info-primary-line-clamp` or `--ha-tile-info-primary-line-height`, remove those and replace with a `::part(primary)` rule. No change needed to the base preamble at this time, but watch for area card name-wrapping regressions and verify the `overflow-wrap: anywhere` default is acceptable within LCARS-styled area cards.

---

### Component: `ha-init-page` — Launch screen `<p>` gains conditional class

**What changed:** In `src/layouts/ha-init-page.ts`, the loading paragraph now conditionally carries the class `loading-text`:

```html
<!-- BEFORE -->
<p>…</p>

<!-- AFTER -->
<p class=${classMap({ "loading-text": !this.migration })}>…</p>
```

**Effect on ha-lcars:** If any ha-lcars card-mod rule targets `ha-init-page p` directly (for example to style the LCARS boot/launch screen text colour or font), it will continue to work because the `<p>` element still exists. However, any rule that was written expecting the `<p>` to have **no** class and is now scope-guarded on `.loading-text` (or conversely relies on the absence of a class) would behave differently. The ha-lcars preamble does not currently contain a `ha-init-page` selector, so there is no immediate breakage.

**Suggested fix:** No fix required for the current preamble. If a future theme variant adds init-page styling, use `ha-init-page p.loading-text` rather than bare `ha-init-page p` to be forward-compatible.

## LOW IMPACT

### Component: `hui-iframe-card` and `hui-weblink-row` — URL sanitization (no visual change)

**What changed:** Both `hui-iframe-card` and `hui-weblink-row` now call `sanitizeUrl()` on their configured URLs and throw `"Invalid URL"` for `javascript:` and similar schemes. `handle-action.ts` does the same for `url`-type tap actions.

**Effect on ha-lcars:** Purely behavioural. No CSS properties, element names, shadow DOM slots, or custom properties are affected. LCARS dashboards that use weblink rows or iframe cards with normal `https://` URLs are unaffected.

**Suggested fix:** No fix needed.

---

### Component: `hui-numeric-input-card-feature-editor` — Default style changed from `"buttons"` to `"slider"`

**What changed:** The editor default for `NumericInputCardFeatureConfig.style` was corrected from `"buttons"` to `"slider"`.

**Effect on ha-lcars:** This is an editor-side default, not a rendered card change. The LCARS theme does not target the numeric input card feature editor by name. No visual regression is expected on existing dashboard cards (their saved configs are unaffected).

**Suggested fix:** No fix needed. If ha-lcars has specific styling for the numeric input slider vs. buttons feature appearance, verify it still looks correct when the feature is freshly added with no explicit style override.

---

### Component: `get-dashboard-documentation-url` — Custom card/badge documentation URLs sanitized

**What changed:** `getCardDocumentationURL` and `getBadgeDocumentationURL` now wrap the returned `documentationURL` in `sanitizeHttpUrl()`, returning `undefined` for non-http(s) URLs.

**Effect on ha-lcars:** Affects documentation link rendering in the Lovelace card picker. No LCARS CSS targets this area. No visual impact.

**Suggested fix:** No fix needed.
